text_block_list.text: One day, during training—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Lately, our training has mostly centered 
around "catching your breath" mid-run, 
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
And slope training, prioritizing reps over 
speed to build up stamina...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Could your next race happen to be a 
Long-distance one?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Oh boy. It hasn't been announced 
yet, so keep this off the record.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand. I shall only concern 
myself with her physical condition, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer <username>. Good work today.

It seems that she—magazine reporter 
Otonashi-san— came for an interview, but 
even so...
choice_data_list: You really know a lot about Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as a journalist, I possess at least a 
baseline level of knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Having knowledge enables me to write 
better articles, after all.

Ms. Otonashi seems to take the Umamusume 
even more seriously than I had thought.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!? My apologies. I ended up talking 
all about myself.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Since we've crossed paths like this, I 
would love the chance to interview the 
girl you train.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Only as far as you are comfortable 
sharing, are there any issues or 
challenges you are currently facing?

She insists she is strictly a reporter, 
but I thought her knowledge might be 
dependable—
choice_data_list: My lack of power is the problem, though...
Speed is still an issue for me, though...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Did you just say... strength...!? 
Th-That's wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
For developing power, uphill training and 
weight training are effective...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, the absolute essential is the 
food! Food that builds supple and 
resilient muscles!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To think you are prepared to go 
gather ingredients yourself— Okinawan pork 
for longevity, bird's nests from sheer 
cliffs, and even deep-sea fish from the 
ocean floor—all for the ultimate meal...

(I didn't mentally prepare myself for 
that, but the discussion about meals was 
very useful.)

A few days later—while it wasn't a 
deep-sea fish, I caught some white fish 
great for building muscle and treated <chrname> to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Did you just say 'speed'... loud and 
clear!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"If you're seeking speed, managing body 
fat percentage to cut weight without 
losing muscle is key..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
However, that is a very harsh ordeal. Some 
girls even fall out of shape from the 
stress.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, you must do your best to 
prevent stress from building up in your 
Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... To think you are prepared to rent 
out an amusement park, book a cruise on a 
luxury liner, and even arrange a 
transcontinental overseas trip...

(I didn't mentally prepare myself for 
that, but the discussion on body fat 
percentage was very useful.)

A few days later, as a reward for her 
grueling training, we couldn't go on a 
cruise or trip abroad, but <chrname> and I were 
able to let our hair down.
